findings.title: Food obtained from approved source.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed a low risk establishment selling cut melon, cut pumpkin, and samosas. The samosas were not packaged, and set so that customers could self serve with tongs into a to-go clam shell container.  Due to the fact that the facility is only permitted as a low risk establishment, there is to be no food handling.
CORRECTED- the person in charge (PIC) removed the aforementioned items from service. If the facility is interested in increasing their risk classification permit, they must have a pre-opening with the Food Program Manager of Sangamon County Department of Public Health. Any facility handling food is required to have a hand sink for hand washing, and a triple sink so that utensils can be appropriately washed, rinsed, and sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 3-201.11(A) Compliance with Food Law. (A) FOOD shall be obtained from sources that comply with LAW. [P]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: 1st REPEAT: Gaskets on doors #2, 3, 4, and 6 were observed loose and separating from the doors. Repair or replace the broken gaskets.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.11(B) Good Repair and Proper Adjustment. (B) EQUIPMENT components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are in need of repair:
1) Damaged floor tiles were observed around the back door.
2) Caulking along the restroom handsink is not smooth or easily cleanable. Recaulk the sink so the seal is smooth.
3) The walk-in cooler floor is rusted and needs to be painted or otherwise resealed.
4) Low bare wood shelves are used to lift items in the walk-in cooler and freezer to 6 inches off the ground. Paint or otherwise seal the bare wood surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]
